title: Exoticious Homes
description: A Plugin that adds /spawn and /home features to the game. Works straight out of the box and integrates with LP.
body:
## A BRAND NEW PLUGIN THAT IS VERY LIGHTWEIGHT AND SIMPLE.

FEATURES:
- TP to spawn feature. (/spawn) with customisable delay.
- TP to HOME(s) feature. (/home [home-name])
- /setspawn (ADMIN-ONLY)
- /sethome [name-here] (works for every player on JAVA & BEDROCK)

INTEGRATES WELL WITH [LuckPerms](https://modrinth.com/plugin/luckperms) & [Geyser](https://modrinth.com/plugin/geyser)
